title: DiffIR
description: Tool-agnostic normalized diff between read-back deployed state and the regenerated golden target. A per-tool adapter (E3) produces this IR; the shared reward core reads it. Reward 1 = zero normalized diff (every resource unchanged).

resources.description: One entry per golden/deployed resource, after normalization (canonical order; AWS-assigned ids/timestamps/suffixes dropped).

address.description: Normalized structural/logical address (never a physical AWS id).

expected.description: Golden value — any JSON. Intentionally unconstrained here; the per-resource value shape and number normalization (including the large-number-as-string rule) are fixed where the diff IR is produced. Absent when the property was added in deployed state.

actual.description: Deployed value — any JSON, same caveat as `expected`. Absent when the property is missing from deployed state.
